# Elastic wins Google Cloud's Global Technology Partner of the Year Award


By


[Aleta Hubbell](https://www.elastic.co/blog/author/aleta-hubbell)


August 29, 2023

Share on Twitter

We are happy to announce that Elastic


®


has won the 2023 Google Cloud Global Technology Partner of the Year Award. This prestigious award is given to one Google Cloud partner at the forefront of digital innovation working with Google Cloud to solve today's biggest global challenges.


## A partnership inspired by our customers


The Elastic and Google Cloud partnership is driven by a shared commitment to deliver unparalleled value to our customers. As a top-tier Global ISV and recognized as a Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader in Insight Engines, Elastic's successful partnership with Google Cloud has significantly grown due to our joint investment in product and go-to-market motions. We now have over 2,600 customers using the power of Elastic on Google Cloud to accelerate time to insights.


There's strong, proven collaboration between Elastic and Google Cloud, which validated our decision to adopt solutions from both companies.


###### Jérémy Simon, Service Manager of DataCentric at Auchan Retail


## A partnership built on growth and innovation


Elastic and Google Cloud remain at the forefront of innovation. We are steadfast in our commitment to expanding and improving technology, including AI,


[Elasticsearch Relevance Engine TM (ESRE TM )](https://www.elastic.co/blog/may-2023-launch-announcement) , and support for Vertex AI large language models (LLMs). Recent enhancements include support for Google's Cloud Security Command Center, which integrates Google alerts and security events into


[Elastic Security for SIEM](https://www.elastic.co/security/siem) . In addition, Elastic's support for Google's managed Kubernetes environment, GKE Autopilot, and serverless and agentless observability and security integrations make it easier than ever to fully leverage Elastic on Google Cloud.


When you combine the power of Elastic with the scale of Google Cloud Platform, there are near endless possibilities.


###### Ciro Rizzo, Head of Engineering, Platforms, Telegraph Media Group


## A partnership focused on customer success


Elastic and Google Cloud have partnered to help enterprises of all sizes deploy Elasticsearch, Observability, and Security on Google Cloud to derive powerful, real-time insights from your data in minutes. For example, Cisco used Elastic and Google Cloud to power its enterprise search platform resulting in:


- Up to 73% faster search queries


- 90% of support requests resolved with the new platform


- 5,000 support engineer hours saved per month


When you combine the accuracy and speed of Elastic, and the power of Google Cloud, you can build a very stable and cost-efficient search platform that also delivers a delightful experience for the user.


###### Sujith Joseph, Principal Enterprise Search & Cloud Architect, Cisco Systems


## A partnership built for you


Elastic’s winning of the 2023 Google Cloud Global Technology Partner of the Year Award is a direct result of the strength of our partnership and the power of our joint solution. If you’d like to learn more, visit the


[Elastic and Google Cloud partnership page](https://www.elastic.co/partners/google-cloud) . If you are ready to turn your data challenges into opportunities, head to the


[Elastic listing on the Google Cloud Marketplace](https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/product/elastic-prod/elastic-cloud?utm_source=elastic&utm_medium=elastic_website&utm_campaign=partner_page&project=prod-elastic-cloud-billing) to get started.


*The release and timing of any features or functionality described in this post remain at Elastic's sole discretion. Any features or functionality not currently available may not be delivered on time or at all.*
